name: Plenoxels Training with Progressive Growing
definition: A training procedure for Plenoxels that uses progressive growing of the receptive field size to optimize a 3D voxel grid from multi-view images, incorporating TV loss and beta loss for regularization.
summary: Plenoxels Training with Progressive Growing optimizes 3D voxel grids from multi-view images by progressively refining receptive fields, reducing training time and improving convergence stability.
